author: (Espinosa & Ortea, 2000)

note.en: A tiny polished snail, only a few millimetres long, that lives among sand and rubble and is hardly ever seen without a hand lens. Known here from 3 museum specimen records (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, 2000 to 2003).
note.es: Un caracol diminuto y pulido, de pocos milímetros, que vive entre arena y escombro coralino y casi nunca se ve sin una lupa. Conocido aquí por 3 registros de ejemplares de museo (Gandoca-Manzanillo refugio, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, 2000 a 2003).

evidence: GBIF: 3 specimen records in the region (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, Punta Mona, 2000 to 2003)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
